message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data or configuration parameters anywhere in the shown code.

No detected untrusted source handling: The code reads local config files and checkpoints but performs no remote data fetching, and there are no checksum verifications, signed URLs, or pinned revisions present.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is present anywhere in the data-flow path shown.

No detected model integrity verification: The code resumes from the latest checkpoint found via glob without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify the integrity of the loaded weights.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, verifies expected label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor detection mechanisms such as trigger scanning, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: There is no use of Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, or any other differential privacy mechanism in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are referenced anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Evaluation uses a validation dataloader (self.dataloader.val) rather than a strictly isolated held-out test set, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and while multiple metrics exist they are not independently verified against manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: No input validation, shape checks, range checks, or schema validation are performed on incoming data before passing it to the model anywhere in the visible inference path.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or output bounds validations applied to model outputs before they are returned or used downstream.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a generative/VAE-based vision or vector model pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
